newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton market sees thin business.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton market sees thin business.

text.p: Nearby offering rates for most non-US cottons were barely affected by Friday's decline on New York futures, so trading was dull on most European raw cotton markets.

A price-testing inquiry was evident for popular Central Asian and African Franc Zone styles, on which nearby availability continued to dwindle. The volume of new business being seriously discussed seemed very thin.
